title: English Practice Quiz 0925
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A stocktake involves ___.
questions.explanation: counting physical inventory is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: FIFO means ___.
questions.explanation: First In, First Out is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A reorder level indicates when stock should be ___.
questions.explanation: replenished is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A stock discrepancy should be ___.
questions.explanation: investigated and documented is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A batch number identifies ___.
options: a particular production or supply lot
questions.explanation: a particular production or supply lot is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Perishable goods must be stored according to ___.
questions.explanation: specified temperature and handling requirements is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Obsolete stock is stock that is ___.
questions.explanation: no longer current or useful is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A goods received note records ___.
questions.explanation: items delivered and received is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Stock rotation helps reduce ___.
questions.explanation: expiry and deterioration is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A minimum stock level helps prevent ___.
questions.explanation: shortages of essential items is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.
